# BUSCO results

## generic

eukaryota_odb10

```{r}
path <- '~/project_data/downy/busco_results/'
read.summary <- function(file) {
    data <- fromJSON(file)$result %>% as.data.frame %>% select(-c(one_line_summary))
    df <- data %>% cbind(name = basename(dirname(file)), .) 
    return(df)
}

files <- list.files(path, pattern = 'generic', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>% str_subset('json')
map_dfr(files, read.summary) %>% gt
```

## specific

stramenopiles_odb10

```{r}
files <- list.files(path, pattern = 'specific', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>% str_subset('json')
```
